newsitem.title: USA: Andersen Worldwide postpones partner meeting.
newsitem.headline: Andersen Worldwide postpones partner meeting.

text.p: Andersen Worldwide SC said on Monday that it postponed its scheduled September 27 meeting of all Andersen Worldwide's partners.
The company had scheduled the meeting to discuss an appropriate organization structure to meet the needs of the firm's clients in the future.
However, Anderson's board has determined that additional work is necessary before it would have a proposal to present to its partners.
Andersen's board agreed to convene in the coming weeks a series of smaller, regional meetings.
Andersen Worldwide said revenues increased 16 percent in the fiscal year ended August 31, 1996, to $9.4 billion from $8.1 billion in the previous year.

Andersen Worldwide is comprised of two business units -- Arthur Andersen for audit, tax, business advisory and specialty consulting services, and Andersen Consulting for global management and technology consulting.
